nodes.name: Load Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Validates every setting. Throws (stopping the run) on any configuration error.

nodes.name: Run Demo Audit
nodes.notes: Runs the full audit against the bundled demo dataset. No network calls.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Account Details
nodes.notes: GET /account-info/v3/details, used by the sandbox check.

nodes.name: Enforce Sandbox & Plan Record Fetch
nodes.notes: Stops unless the portal is a sandbox or developer test account (when SANDBOX_MODE=true).

nodes.name: HubSpot: List Custom Object Records
nodes.notes: GET /crm/v3/objects/{objectTypeId}, paginated with "after". maxRequests 100 x 100 per page = 10,000 records per object.

nodes.name: Plan Association Reads
nodes.notes: One v4 batch read per 100 records per required parent type.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Associations (v4)
nodes.notes: POST /crm/v4/associations/{from}/{to}/batch/read. A 207 response is normal: records without associations come back as errors.

nodes.name: Plan Target Verification
nodes.notes: Checks every association read was answered, then plans parent-record reads.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Parent Records
nodes.notes: POST /crm/v3/objects/{type}/batch/read. Finds deleted parents and applies targetWhen criteria.

nodes.name: Evaluate Integrity
nodes.notes: Pure evaluation. Produces the report and the flag plan.

nodes.name: Plan Flag Writes
nodes.notes: Outputs batch updates only when DRY_RUN=false and FLAG_WRITES_ENABLED=true.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Update Integrity Flags
nodes.notes: POST /crm/v3/objects/{type}/batch/update. Writes are idempotent, so retries are safe.

nodes.name: Build Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Builds Block Kit and decides the target: production only in live mode, otherwise the sandbox webhook or log-only.

nodes.name: Slack: Send Integrity Alert
nodes.notes: The webhook URL is read from $env at request time, so it never appears in item data.

nodes.name: Build Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Runs when this workflow is its own Error Workflow (Workflow Settings > Error Workflow). Secrets are redacted.

nodes.name: Slack: Send Failure Alert
nodes.notes: The webhook URL is read from $env at request time, so it never appears in item data.

parameters.content:
## Association Integrity Guard: safety defaults
- **Demo mode** while HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN is a placeholder: bundled data, no HubSpot calls.
- **DRY_RUN=true** (default): reads HubSpot, never writes flags.
- **SANDBOX_MODE=true** (default): refuses non-sandbox portals; alerts only go to SLACK_SANDBOX_WEBHOOK_URL.
- **FLAG_WRITES_ENABLED=false** (default): a second opt-in for writes.
- Read stages fail closed: an incomplete read stops the run before any write.
- Circuit breaker: an object with an implausible orphan rate gets no flag writes.
